tasks.label: Démarrer l'environnement Docker TP Linux (Jupyter + Fish)
tasks.command: chmod +x "${PWD}/.vscode/docker-kernel.py" && mkdir -p "${HOME}/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/bash" "${HOME}/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/python3" && sed "s|/home/aptitek/Documents/Courses/labs/linux|${PWD}|g" "${PWD}/.vscode/kernels/bash/kernel.json" > "${HOME}/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/bash/kernel.json" && sed "s|/home/aptitek/Documents/Courses/labs/linux|${PWD}|g" "${PWD}/.vscode/kernels/python3/kernel.json" > "${HOME}/.local/share/jupyter/kernels/python3/kernel.json" && if [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' tp-linux 2>/dev/null)" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose up -d --build; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose up -d --build; else docker build --target runtime -t tp-linux:local . && (docker rm -f tp-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && docker run -d --name tp-linux --user 1000:1000 -e TERM=xterm-256color -e COLORTERM=truecolor -p 8888:8888 -v "${PWD}/workspace:/home/student/workspace" -it --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --restart unless-stopped tp-linux:local; fi

tasks.label: Ouvrir un terminal Fish dans le conteneur TP Linux
Reconstruire l'environnement Docker TP Linux (--build)
tasks.command: if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose up -d --build --force-recreate; else docker build --target runtime -t tp-linux:local . && (docker rm -f tp-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) && docker run -d --name tp-linux --user 1000:1000 -e TERM=xterm-256color -e COLORTERM=truecolor -p 8888:8888 -v "${PWD}/workspace:/home/student/workspace" -it --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --restart unless-stopped tp-linux:local; fi
